title: galarhoeus inderiensis
intro: Galarhoeus inderiensis, commonly known as Himalayan spurge, is a plant species belonging to the Euphorbiaceae family. This plant is reported to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-diabetic properties. The therapeutic actions of Galarhoeus inderiensis include its ability to reduce inflammation, protect against oxidative stress, and modulate glucose metabolism. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
